description:
Analysis extent for Flood, Democratic Republic of the Congo, 18 November 2019 (FL20191118COD): 5 features merged from 5 source layers. Layers whose names mark the area UNOSAT analysed, or parts of it with no usable imagery (analysis extent, area of interest, cloud obstruction, no-data, image footprint). The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Satellite-detected flood waters over Mobayi-Mbongo, Nord-Ubangi Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/flood-waters-over-mobayi-mbongo-nord-ubangi-province-democratic-republic-of-the-congo)
- [Satellite-detected flood waters, as of 12 November 2019, over Zongo, Democratic Republic of the Congo](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/flood-waters-as-of-12-november-2019-over-zongo-democratic-republic-of-the-congo)
- [Satellite-detected flood waters, as of 15 November 2019, Libenge, Libenge Territory, Democratic Republic of the Congo](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/flood-waters-as-of-15-november-2019-libenge-libenge-territory-democratic-republic-of-the-c)
- [Satellite-detected flooded structures, as of 12 November 2019, over Zongo, Democratic Republic of the Congo](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/flooded-structures-as-of-12-november-2019-over-zongo-democratic-republic-of-the-congo)
- [Satellite-detected flooded structures, as of 15 November 2019, over Libenge, Democratic Republic of the Congo](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/flooded-structures-as-of-15-november-2019-over-libenge-democratic-republic-of-the-congo)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: Area_m2
table:columns.description: Area in square metres, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: Area_ha
table:columns.description: Area in hectares, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Length
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Area
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: SensorDate
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: GlobalID
table:columns.description: ArcGIS global identifier of the feature.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
